output.title: Ingress-shim annotation copying feature applicability unclear
output.content: This change adds an ingress-shim option to copy extra annotations from Ingress resources to Certificate objects. The environment does not explicitly state whether cert-manager ingress-shim is deployed or used for Ingress-based certificate management. Verify if ingress-shim controller is enabled in your cert-manager configuration and whether you use Ingress resources with cert-manager annotations.
